days.title: Lakes and Waterfalls of the High Doubs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lake Moron
stops.detail: A chance to admire the beautiful Lake Moron, the Saut-du-Doubs waterfall and Lake Brenets.

stops.name: Lac des Brenets
stops.detail: The water of the river Doubs, which has been dammed up by landslide debris, forms the four kilometer long, but only 200 meter wide, winding Lac des Brenets.

stops.name: Saut du Doubs
stops.detail: The trail leads to the Saut du Doubs, a spectacular, 27m high waterfall.

stops.name: Le Theusseret

stops.name: Soubey
stops.detail: 15 kilometres of meditative hiking pleasure and one of Switzerland's most beautiful "water trails" run between Soubey and St-Ursanne.
